statement: OC-U can represent articulated system descriptions by typed primitives: state, observable, constraint, operator, projection, invariant, repair class, extension class, evidence binding.
proof_summary: Lean structure Description contains all required primitive surfaces.

statement: If evidence is bound and a same-description repair exists, OC-U classifies structured pressure as absorption.
proof_summary: Lean theorem absorption_theorem proves classify C = absorption.
boundary_note: Existing repair is no longer a counterexample; it is a first-class OC-U outcome.

statement: If evidence is bound, no same-description repair exists, and an extension repair exists, OC-U classifies the case as extension/new-axis.
proof_summary: Lean theorem extension_necessity_theorem proves classify C = extension.
boundary_note: Dimension birth is conditional on no same repair and available extension.

statement: If evidence is bound, no same repair exists, no extension exists, and invariant failure is declared, OC-U classifies the case as collapse.
proof_summary: Lean theorem collapse_theorem proves classify C = collapse.

statement: If evidence is missing, or no repair/extension/failure has been established, OC-U classifies the case as underdetermined.
proof_summary: Lean theorems underdetermined_without_evidence and underdetermined_open_invariant prove underdetermination cases.
boundary_note: Out-of-scope is a formal status, not a hidden failure.

statement: For every StressContext, classify returns absorption, extension, collapse, or underdetermined.
proof_summary: Lean theorem total_stress_response_taxonomy proves the four-response classifier is total.
boundary_note: This is the repaired universal metamodel theorem.

statement: Core projection signature alone cannot inflate into domain validation without local instantiation.
proof_summary: Lean theorem projection_non_inflation and core_signature_alone_not_validation separate core signature from domain validation.
boundary_note: Domain truth requires local instantiation evidence.

statement: The old two-outcome universal fork is incomplete.
proof_summary: Python witness shows absorption is a valid OC-U outcome that is neither extension nor collapse.
boundary_note: Do not reuse old fork as central claim.

statement: Real-domain truth requires local observables, constraints, operators, invariants, and evidence bindings.
proof_summary: Python witness shows an uninstantiated domain case classifies as underdetermined and is not projection-validated.
boundary_note: OC-U is universal metamodel, not automatic empirical validation.
